name: Private Object Storage Boundary and Integrity-Checked Downloads
scope: introduce an ObjectStorage port for original content binaries
retain the private local filesystem implementation with atomic writes, restrictive permissions and safe key validation
add an opt-in boto3 S3-compatible object storage adapter with endpoint, bucket, region and credential configuration
route immutable source-version writes through the storage port
serve originals only through an authenticated API endpoint and recompute SHA-256 before returning bytes
map storage outages to explicit STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE states rather than parse failures
report database, storage and brand pack readiness separately
add offline adapter tests, upload/download integrity integration tests and outage state tests
update phase gate, architecture, setup and AI/provider disclosure records
